head: codex/kpmo-assurance-read-recovery-20261019
title: fix(kpmo): close assurance recovery and remove unavailable launcher gate
body:
## Purpose
Correct the Whole Platform Assurance read/recovery failure and remove the unavailable external bootstrap prerequisite from the narrowly scoped, user-approved reversible branch and Draft PR path.

## Integrated code correction
- Read GitHub workflow history at 100 records per page while retaining the 4 MiB response cap and 40-page bound.
- Preserve resume compatibility with existing per_page=25 checkpoints.
- Retry known shared read-budget CAS contention with bounded jitter; defer on known contention and fail closed on ambiguous outcomes.
- Select sweep candidates by exact workflow path and repository/run bindings, not mutable display names.
- Bind recovery-history cardinality failures to the separately preserved original terminal-null evidence and exact protected evidence.

## Narrow execution policy correction
- Permit only explicitly user-authorized, authenticated updates to non-protected codex/* branches and one Draft PR creation, bound to immutable intent, exact payload digest, live SHA reconciliation, complete PR-state checks, and exact readback.
- Keep protected main, agent dispatch, Ready, approval, merge, workflow dispatch, deployment, Production/Public/G5, provider, credential, and promotion gates closed. No full-root-of-trust or distributed exactly-once claim is made.

## Validation
- 123 focused root-correction tests, 16 approval-envelope tests, 69 recovery-trigger tests, and 22 branch/Draft/policy tests passed.
- AI operating-rules and bootstrap-remediation validators passed.
- Approval inventory was regenerated after the immutable Draft intent and passed envelope validation.
- No natural Assurance run has executed against this proposal; whole-platform closure remains unproven.

## Scope
Draft proposal only. No Ready, approval, merge, dispatch, deployment, Production, Public, or G5 action is requested.
